rawScenePlan.title: Shift Change
rawScenePlan.event: Overhead rails ratchet; a fleet of motorized shelving banks silently rotate and recline, floor panels slide and lock so the main atrium's straight aisles rearrange into a single spiralling corridor. Angle-mounted lamps reorient into narrow pools that trace the new curve. A maintenance trolley, jammed between two rotated racks, drops a small metal tag onto white tile.
rawScenePlan.consequence: the floor now shows a newly formed curved pathway and a lone metal maintenance tag lying on the tile.
rawScenePlan.nextHook: Betriebsform carried forward as the operating arrangement that reorganized the aisles.
rawScenePlan.stillPrompt: Interior still of the Kaufhaus after an automated reconfiguration: empty atrium with rotated shelving forming a spiral corridor, pools of warm and cool light along the curve, a maintenance tag on white tile in foreground. No readable text or logos.
rawScenePlan.videoPrompt: 5-second clip: quiet mechanical sounds; motorized shelving banks rotate and lock into a spiral; lights re-angle into narrow pools; camera dollies slowly along the new curve to reveal the maintenance tag on the floor. No people, no text.
rawScenePlan.cameraCue: After the reconfiguration, the camera pushes forward along the new curved aisle and lingers on the maintenance tag, revealing the changed circulation.

rawScenePlan.title: Cold Display
rawScenePlan.event: Refrigerated display cases that line the spiral fill, each tray populated by uniformly cut slabs of raw meat. Under the new Betriebsform they subtly realign in parallel rows—each slab shudders in a coordinated, millimetric twitch that sends faint rivulets of condensation along the inner glass before settling.
rawScenePlan.consequence: a thermometer slips from a ledge and smashes, leaving a small jagged smear of red on the white floor tile.
rawScenePlan.nextHook: Althochdeutsche Sprache (Fleisch) becomes the dominant object behavior, intensifying the reconfiguration.
rawScenePlan.stillPrompt: Close-up still of refrigerated display cases in the now-curved aisle: neatly stacked slabs of meat under condensation, fine beads traced on the inner glass, one case reflecting the spiral aisle. No people, no monster, no text.
rawScenePlan.videoPrompt: 2-second clip: camera glides past refrigerated cases; the slabs of meat twitch in subtle unison, condensation runs vertically, a thermometer slips and falls out of frame, glass fogs and clears. No monster, no text.
rawScenePlan.cameraCue: After the tiny tremors in the cases, the camera dollies inward to the fallen thermometer and the red smear on the tile, revealing the consequence.

rawScenePlan.title: Label Pulse
rawScenePlan.event: Fluorescent strips along the ceiling begin to pulse in short hazardous cadences; printed hazard-like shapes appear as frost on the inside of the display glass and rearrange into repeating patterns. From behind a column, a weathered practical sculpture—patinated, composite-material, mechanically rigged—slides into view, damp with glass condensation. It moves with puppet-like micro-adjustments and presses a hand to a case; the pressure causes a tray of meat to spiral and a corner pane to crack.
rawScenePlan.consequence: a cracked display case with a jagged opening where meat has spilled slightly inward.
rawScenePlan.nextHook: H- und P-Sätze intensifies the facility's signs and behaviors, now physically fracturing an object.
rawScenePlan.stillPrompt: Still of the weathered practical sculpture partially revealed in the Kaufhaus aisle: damp surface, hand pressed to refrigerated glass, frost-organized hazard patterns on the case, and a visible crack with a jagged opening. No readable text or logos.
rawScenePlan.videoPrompt: 3-second clip: pulsating ceiling lights, frost rearranging into repeated hazard-like symbols, the weathered practical sculpture emerges and, with slow puppet-like motion, presses a hand to the glass causing a tray to spiral and the pane to crack. The sculpture is a filmed practical prop, not CGI.
rawScenePlan.cameraCue: After the crack appears, handheld camera pushes in tight on the jagged opening to frame the damaged interior of the case and the damp texture of the sculpture's hand.

rawScenePlan.title: Evacuation Choreography
rawScenePlan.event: A small cluster of shoppers enters the reorganized spiral, responding to the rhythmic light pulses and the cracked case. Their movements adopt synchronized safety gestures—pointing, stepping back, hands raised in repeated, rehearsed motions—like a bounced echo of the H- und P-Sätze cadence. One child drops a small plastic coin-shaped toy that bounces and skids to rest near the cracked case; the group hurries past without looking back.
rawScenePlan.consequence: a trail of quick wet footprints leading from the crowd toward the cracked display case and the dropped plastic coin beside the opening.
rawScenePlan.nextHook: Public behavior amplifies the hazard rhythm into choreographed evacuation gestures.
rawScenePlan.stillPrompt: Still of shoppers in the Kaufhaus mid-gesture: a small group performing synchronized safety motions in the spiral aisle, blurred faces, a plastic coin near the cracked display case on the tile. No monster, no text.
rawScenePlan.videoPrompt: 2-second clip: camera pans across a group of people moving in staccato evacuation gestures; a child’s plastic coin falls and rolls to a stop beside the cracked case; wet footprints remain on the tile. No monster visible.
rawScenePlan.cameraCue: After the group passes, the camera tilts down to follow the wet footprints leading toward the cracked case, concealing whatever lies beyond the break.

rawScenePlan.title: Smoke and Barricade
rawScenePlan.event: Alarms stutter; a low wall of theatrical smoke blooms from a floor vent in the atrium. Shoppers bolt in panic and scatter into the spiral aisles. In the smoke, the same weathered practical sculpture steps forward with deliberate, heavy measured motions—its surface catching the light—and pushes a collapsed shelving bay across the spiral to form a crude barricade. The movement sends scattered shopping bags tumbling and scuffs a dark, singed patch into the tile where a lamp fell.
rawScenePlan.consequence: a collapsed shelving barricade across the spiral, strewn shopping bags, and a scorched patch on the floor.
rawScenePlan.nextHook: Terrorism disrupts circulation and converts structure into obstruction, leaving visible wreckage.
rawScenePlan.stillPrompt: Wide still of the Kaufhaus atrium filled with theatrical smoke and shoppers scattering as a weathered practical sculpture steps through the haze and pushes a shelving bay into a barricade; shopping bags scatter and a dark scorch marks the tile. No readable text or logos.
rawScenePlan.videoPrompt: 5-second clip: crane moves over a smoke-filled atrium; shoppers scramble into aisles; the weathered practical sculpture advances through haze and heaves a shelving bay into place, creating a barricade; bags tumble; slow-motion for the push. The sculpture is a filmed practical object, not CGI.
rawScenePlan.cameraCue: After the shelving collapses, the crane arcs down and comes to rest over the barricade and the scorched patch, revealing the altered circulation and scattered bags.

rawScenePlan.title: Retail Aftermath
rawScenePlan.event: Smoke thins; shoppers begin to sift through the barricade's debris, picking up and inspecting discarded items as if evaluating value. A woman lifts a white paper bag from the scattered pile—on its side a damp handprint in patinated residue is visible. Instead of fleeing, a small group folds the barricade into a makeshift display and exchange begins: a tidal, pragmatic reallocation of goods.
rawScenePlan.consequence: someone leaves the Kaufhaus carrying a white paper bag marked by a damp weathered handprint, turning wreckage into a carried commodity.
